summary: Iteration 1 tested the public API and Expo Web app end to end. Backend: 18/24 pytest cases passed; core registration/login/me, normal refresh, secure cookies, bcrypt, onboarding, 30-day generation/localization, Pro gating/fallback, task/check-in points, progress, store, knowledge, ICS, regeneration, and Indonesian AI persistence passed. Frontend critical flows passed except store catalogue localization after an unsaved profile language switch.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout is ineffective through the public ingress. Five wrong attempts were followed by a successful valid login (200), not 429. Attempts are split across alternating proxy client hosts.

When an X-Refresh-Token for user A and a refresh_token cookie for user B are both present, the cookie wins and the endpoint issues user B tokens. Normal header-only refresh passes, but the precedence creates cross-account session confusion.
The +50 all-tasks daily bonus can be farmed repeatedly by completing all tasks, un-completing the final task, and completing it again. The second completion awarded another 50.
Malformed start_date='not-a-date' returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of a validated 400/422.

Public preflight responds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, contrary to the required credentialed explicit-origin policy. Backend also configures allow_origins=['*'] with credentials.

minor.issue: scheduled_time has no HH:MM validation; 'not-a-time' is accepted with 200. Such data later makes calendar.ics parsing fail. Test restored the valid value.

ui_bugs.issue: Assistant Markdown such as **bold** is rendered literally, and the tested Indonesian reply was 1020 characters in one large bubble despite the backend instruction to keep replies to 2-4 short paragraphs.

integration_issues.issue: After switching the UI from Indonesian to Arabic using prof-lang-ar and immediately opening Rewards, headings become Arabic but item names/descriptions remain Indonesian. Store fetch uses user.language instead of the current i18n language unless profile is separately saved.

action_items: Key lockout by normalized email and a trusted forwarded client IP (or email alone), not request.client.host behind alternating ingress proxies; retest five failures then 429.
Make X-Refresh-Token take precedence when explicitly supplied, or reject requests containing conflicting cookie/header refresh identities.
Persist a once-per-user/date all-tasks bonus marker and make task completion/point award atomic to prevent toggle and concurrent farming.
Validate challenge start_date and task scheduled_time with typed Pydantic date/time fields and return 400/422.
Configure explicit allowed origins with credential support at both app and ingress CORS layers.
Fetch store catalogue using current i18n lang, or persist language immediately when its profile chip is pressed.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 851 lines and should be split into auth, challenges/tasks, check-ins/progress, store/content, and coach routers.

Point mutations are read-then-write across separate operations; task completion and redemption are vulnerable to concurrent duplicate awards/overspending without conditional atomic updates or transactions.
Several frontend API loaders use try/finally without a user-visible catch/error state, so backend failures can leave empty screens with no explanation.
The requested task-count rules mathematically total 107 (3x2 + 7x3 + 20x4), not 111. The API returned 107 and all per-day count rules passed; product requirements should correct the stated total.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ihyaa_*, TEST_lockout_*, TEST_fallback_*, TEST_lockdiag_*, and TEST_ui_* throwaway users/challenges through public endpoints. No user-delete endpoint exists, so these records remain; coach API history was cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest the six failing pytest cases after fixes. Frontend registration/onboarding, task toggle/evidence, check-in, all five tabs, calendar day selection/download/reminder notice, progress visuals, disabled rewards, profile edit/theme, knowledge expansion, Google redirect, and AI reply rendering were exercised successfully. Use fresh throwaway accounts for lockout/onboarding.
rca_of_the_issue: Lockout diagnostics showed one email's attempts split between identifiers 10.79.142.66:<email> and 10.79.142.69:<email>, proving request.client.host is an ingress hop rather than a stable caller. Refresh uses token = cookie or header, so cookie incorrectly overrides the explicit header. Bonus logic only checks whether remaining tasks equal zero and stores no daily-awarded marker. Invalid date/time strings reach date.fromisoformat/split parsing because request models use unconstrained str. Store localization reads user.language while the profile chip only changes local i18n state until a later save.
